name: Index
tagline: Clear, compact and easy to scan
rationale: A carefully typeset catalogue keeps every subject within reach. Size, selection and the next download action are visible without turning the screen into a settings form.
designNote: Plan: white, ink, restrained blue and neutral rules; Helvetica Neue at a clear 28/17/12.5 scale. Layout [identity] / [heading + explanation] / [all/saved tabs] / [7 subject rows] / [download] / [navigation]. Left aligned. Critique: replaced editorial eyebrows and decorative numbering with task-based tabs. Dividers separate actionable rows, not newspaper columns.
